# Faisal Consulting

> Faisal Consulting is the consultancy of Faisal Mahmud, a fractional and interim marketing director based in Alicante, Spain, working across the UK and Europe. It helps leadership teams trace wasted spend, broken tracking and unclear accountability back to the source, then fix the few issues that move the commercial number.

## About Faisal Mahmud
- Role: Fractional Marketing Director (also works as Fractional CMO and Interim Marketing Director).
- Location: Alicante, Spain. Works across the UK and Europe. Engagements run in English; working Spanish.
- Experience: performance and digital marketing leadership at Mars, Tata Communications, Bupa Global and Royal Mail, plus ExSeed Health and ActionAid.
- Proof points published on the site: 75%+ reported year-on-year campaign efficiency improvement across 13 brands at Mars; digital revenue contribution grown from £450K to £9M in two years at Tata Communications.
- Ways to work together: fractional (one to three days per week), interim (full-time for a defined period), project (fixed scope) and advisory (monthly retainer). Fees are agreed to scope.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/performance-marketing-and-digital-strategy/
- Contact: hello@faisalconsulting.co.uk
- Book a 15 minute discovery call: https://calendly.com/hello-faisalconsulting/30min
